newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat will probably attend summit, Egypt says.
newsitem.headline: Arafat will probably attend summit, Egypt says.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will probably take part in a Middle East summit in Washington this week, an Egyptian official said on Monday.
"He will probably go," said presidential adviser Osama el-Baz, who took part in consultations between Arafat and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Monday.
The Palestinian ambassador to Cairo, Zuhdi el-Kudra, told reporters at Cairo airport: "It hasn't been decided yet." Asked when Arafat would decide, he said: "Tonight."
Arafat himself, asked if he would attend, said only: "I have now a meeting with the Troika (of European Union foreign ministers) and I am going to meet the Troika."
Baz said Egypt would have to decide very shortly whether Mubarak would go to the summit, called by President Bill Clinton in response to violence between Israelis and Palestinians.
